# Endurance

> > Endurance is Active.com's platform for managing endurance events, participant tracking, and agency operations across the United States and Canada.

Endurance provides comprehensive tools for event organizers and agencies to create, manage, and track endurance events and participants. The platform streamlines agency onboarding, event registration, and participant management through intuitive forms and location-based setup.

## Key Topics

- Agency Creation
- Event Registration
- Participant Tracking
- Account Signup
- Onboarding
- Form Setup
- Location Selection
- Active.com
- United States
- Canada

## Agency Management

- [Agency Creation](https://endurance.active.com/agency/create?theme=theme1): Endurance agency creation and onboarding form with location selection
